scan_linter_check.description:
Flags current.update() in Business Rules whose timing makes it unnecessary or harmful, using the rule's configured When value: - before: changes to current are saved when the rule finishes, so update() saves the record twice and can run this table's Business Rules again. - after: update() saves the record a second time and can run this table's Business Rules again; field changes belong in a before rule. - display: update() saves the record every time a form displays it.
Async rules are not flagged here: saving current can be legitimate there. SN-BR-002 covers async rules that can trigger themselves.
Only Business Rules (sys_script) are checked; current.update() in UI Actions, Script Includes and other scripts is not in scope. A preceding current.setWorkflow(false) is noted in the finding but does not suppress it, because the extra save remains.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-BR-001: Unnecessary current.update() in a Business Rule
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Remove current.update(). In a before rule, set fields on current and let the save persist them. If the logic must run after the save, move the field changes to a before rule. In a display rule, do not save the record.
scan_linter_check.short_description: current.update() in a before, after or display Business Rule.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-BR-001: Unnecessary current.update() in a Business Rule
